title: Apply the dimension-5 transfer to X102's 365-edge state
body:
## Summary
- The dimension-4 transfer leaves X102 on 365 edges. Dimension 5 grants X102 no new read.
- The interval transfer adds 1,360 edges from 172 departure slots on 97 channels. The resulting 1,725 edges are the archived forward cone.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The backward cone is not built. The receipt includes a SHA-256 digest of the 1,725 reached edge indices.

## Test plan
